CurrentWeek.Name: Current MAUL week
CurrentWeek.Hint: 0 = pre-season, 1 = after tryouts ... 6 = after the finale. Change it from MAUL GM tools.

Webhook.Name: Discord webhook URL (optional)
Webhook.Hint: If set, the module posts a short message to this Discord webhook when a player finds a secret office or triggers another notify-the-GM interactable. World settings can be read by player clients, so anyone in the world could find this URL.

ShowHints.Name: Show interaction hints
ShowHints.Hint: Show a bouncing ! over interactables within one tile of the player's token. The highlighted tile can also be clicked.

ShowWeekChip.Name: Show MAUL calendar chip
ShowWeekChip.Hint: Show the small date / week chip at the top of the screen.

TextSpeed.Name: Dialogue text speed
TextSpeed.Hint: Characters per second for the typewriter effect. 0 = show each box instantly.

SfxVolume.Name: MAUL: sound effects
SfxVolume.Hint: Volume of the little 8-bit sounds: talk blips, the notice chime, coins, the leyline whoosh. 0 = off. Only affects you.

MusicVolume.Name: MAUL: music volume
MusicVolume.Hint: Volume of the mall music, which changes as you walk between areas. 0 = off. Only affects you; starts after your first key press or click.

Menu.Name: MAUL GM tools
Menu.Label: Open GM tools
Menu.Hint: Build mall scenes, advance the week, create player users, view or reset player progress, discoveries, character logs and update files.

Interact.Name: Interact (Mall Explorer)
Interact.Hint: Talk to / inspect the thing next to your token. Also advances the dialogue box.

TogglePause.Name: MAUL: Pause / unpause the game (GM)
TogglePause.Hint: Shift+Space or the Pause key. Plain Space talks to people inside the malls, so pausing lives here.

Search.Name: MAUL: Search
Search.Hint: Search the area around your token (Perception roll) for hidden things. Once per spot per minute.

StoreNames.Name: MAUL: Store names
StoreNames.Hint: Show or hide every store's name on the map.

Feedback.Name: MAUL: Notebook (notes for Zak)
Feedback.Hint: Open your notebook: write a note, idea or problem for Zak about where you stand, something you pick on the map, a store or an item, and see the notes you've sent.

MallMap.Name: Mall directory map
MallMap.Hint: Open the map of this mall: every store, what it sells, and where you are.
